summary:
Python and AI developer with 1.3+ years of professional experience in software development, backend engineering and
artificial intelligence systems. Strong hands-on expertise in Python, Django, REST API development, distributed systems,
automation pipelines, and LLM based application including RAG architectures. Experienced in building scalable secure, and
production ready systems deployed on cloud platforms.

bullets: Hatch – AI Powered Document Processing Platform:
Designed, developed, and maintained scalable backend services using Python and Django for automated document processing.
Implemented OAuth 2.0 based Dropbox integration with secure refresh-token management for continuous synchronization.
Architected a distributed OCR processing system using Celery workers, Redis, and dual-LLM load balancing (Mistral and OpenAI).
Improved system performance by reducing OCR processing latency by 70–80% and enabled high-volume processing of over 10,000 documents within 3–4 hours.
Built automated metadata extraction pipelines and spreadsheet generation workflows integrated directly with cloud storage. Project: CoreliaOS – Multi-Agent AI Workspace Platform
Led a 3-member development team to design and implement a secure multi-agent AI workspace using Django, React, LangChain, and LangGraph.
Developed and deployed multiple AI agents including Legal, Finance, Product Management, Translation, Gmail, Google Drive, and Slack agents.
Implemented per-user isolated knowledge bases with strict data segregation and secure OAuth integrations.
Enabled agent-to-agent collaboration, document analysis, contextual retrieval, and persistent chat history in a production environment. Project: EditHX – Document Intelligence RAG System

Developed a Python-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) chatbot for intelligent document understanding. Implemented semantic search for better accuracy. Project: Zarn – AI-Based Test Preparation Platform

Built backend services in Python integrated with Azure AI services and Azure-hosted databases. Developed web interfaces using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for IELTS and competitive exam preparation workflows. Project: AI Job Scraper Board – Automation and Data Enrichment System

Designed and implemented automation workflows using n8n to scrape job postings from LinkedIn and Indeed. Integrated Apollo API to enrich job and company data. Project: Tailblazer – AI Agent Platform for Pet Welfare
Designed and implemented AI agent workflows using n8n for pet safety and welfare use cases.
knowledge of Flutter and Dart to create multiple applications.
Developed 2 applications for school management system namely the parent's app and the teacher's app.
